bio.name: Tanishk Khare
bio.summary: Passionate software developer skilled in building scalable, real-world applications using modern web technologies. Currently expanding expertise in full-stack development, AI-powered interfaces, and production-grade backend systems.

projects.title: Voice Portfolio AI
projects.description: An interactive voice-based AI portfolio that simulates a phone-call experience. Users ask questions and receive real-time AI responses using speech synthesis.
features: Embedded knowledge base for smart question answering

projects.title: Second Brain — Idea & Knowledge Management App
projects.description: A MERN + TypeScript productivity application that acts as your personal second brain. It helps you store ideas, links, thoughts, and insights in one organized space so they never get lost (like when texting yourself on WhatsApp).
features: Save ideas, links, notes, and inspirations instantly
JWT-based authentication with secure user accounts
Share your collection with others via a public link
Clean, fast, and minimal UI designed for quick capture
challenges: Designing a smooth user flow for fast idea capture
Building shareable public pages with secure access
Ensuring consistent performance with large note collections

projects.title: Nutriwell — Nutrition & Wellness Platform
projects.description: A full-stack production-grade application for consultation bookings, diet plans, user forms, WhatsApp integration, and admin tools.
features: Admin panel with full patient history

experience.description: Working on full-stack development using Next.js, Prisma ORM, PostgreSQL, and modern backend architectures. Building production-grade REST APIs, reusable UI components, and real-world client-facing features.
Worked on data annotation, LiDAR technology processing, and fundamentals of AI/ML data pipelines.
Built multiple real-world applications including AI voice portfolio, course selling backend, and full-stack health consultation platform.
